title: WayloGroundingEvalCase
description: One row of eval/cases.csv — a single (screenshot, findDescription, ground-truth answer) grounding eval case. See eval/README.md for how these are built and what 'pass' means when replaying a case against a detector.

case_id.description: Stable, unique identifier. Never renumber existing cases.

app.description: The app the screenshot is from, e.g. 'YouTube'. Matches Plan.appName where applicable.

screen_description.description: Plain-English description of the screen/state shown, for a human skimming the CSV without opening the image.

findDescription.description: The exact (or realistic) backend-style find description for this step — same field/format as Step.findDescription in PlanParser.kt.

expected_label.description: The correct element's own visible text or contentDescription — the human-verified ground truth. May be empty for a pure image-only target with no text/contentDescription at all (rely on expected_position_hint instead).

expected_position_hint.description: Plain-English location description, used when expected_label alone is ambiguous (icon-only elements, duplicate text on screen).

category.description: text = text-labeled button/list item. icon = app icon or icon-only button with no visible text. nav = bottom nav bar / tab bar item. profile = profile picture/avatar, usually image-only.

notes.description: Known ambiguity, rationale for the case, or 'EXAMPLE — replace with a real labeled screenshot' for placeholder rows.

screenshot_path.description: Optional. Relative path to the actual screenshot file, e.g. eval/screenshots/yt-001.png. Omitted/blank for placeholder EXAMPLE rows, which have no backing image yet.
